items.name: Healing Salve
items.description:

Heals 500 HP over 40 seconds on a friendly unit.
items.notes: The effect is dispelled if the target is attacked or damaged by an ability that does at least 20 damage (before the damage is modified).

Active Invisibility

An invisible hero is untargetable by the enemy unless detected.
Invisibility is lost if the hero attacks, uses a damage spell, or casts a fight spell.
